scenes.headline: How a 2.6B model holds a minute of world
scenes.sub: SANA-WM: one image, a camera path, sixty seconds of 720p.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lupin! SANA-WM turns one picture and a camera path into a minute of video. Here's how.

scenes.text: Step the cheap linear layers one frame at a time, keep a few exact softmax layers, and feed the camera in twice.
scenes.say: The idea: run cheap linear layers one frame at a time, keep a few exact layers, and give it the camera twice.

scenes.title: From one picture to a minute

steps.say: An autoencoder squeezes eight frames into one, and each patch into one token.
A minute becomes a hundred and six thousand tokens. Too many for full attention.
The camera path joins them in a twenty block transformer: fifteen linear, five softmax.
A much larger refiner then sharpens the result.

scenes.title: A gated delta rule, one frame per step
scenes.say: The linear blocks keep a small memory per head, updated once per frame.

parts.note: decay the old state, erase what this frame corrects
parts.say: The old state decays, and what this frame contradicts is erased.
Then the frame writes what it adds.

parts.note: keys scaled so it can never blow up
parts.say: Scaled keys keep a minute of steps from blowing up.

steps.say: Three delta blocks carry a running summary.
Every fourth block is exact softmax attention. Five times over.
The camera enters twice: one pose inside attention, then rays for all eight raw frames.

scenes.title: What the softmax layers can see

steps.label: full history
steps.say: Keeping the whole past, softmax memory grows every chunk.

steps.label: streaming window
steps.note: plus the first chunk as a sink
steps.say: The streaming release keeps only the first chunk and the last. The middle lives on in the small state.
On one consumer card, a distilled four bit stage one denoises a minute in thirty-four seconds, no refiner.
All-softmax runs out of memory at forty seconds.

scenes.title: Rotation error, simple paths
scenes.say: Following the camera is where it wins: under half the rotation error of larger models, on the authors' benchmark.

scenes.text: A frame-stepped linear state makes a minute affordable; the few exact layers are the expensive part.
scenes.say: Stepping a linear state frame by frame makes a minute affordable. The exact layers are the expensive part.

recap: Camera in twice: poses and rays
scenes.say: Fifteen linear blocks, five exact ones, and a camera fed in twice.
